install_steps: curl -LO https://mirror.openshift.com/pub/openshift-v4/clients/ocp/stable/openshift-client-linux.tar.gz && tar xzf openshift-client-linux.tar.gz oc && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && mv oc ~/.local/bin/ && rm -f openshift-client-linux.tar.gz kubectl README.md
note: The tarball also ships kubectl; extract just 'oc' to avoid clobbering an existing kubectl install. For arm64 use openshift-client-linux-arm64.tar.gz. Also available via Homebrew (brew install openshift-cli).
